funFacts: Sharks can detect a drop of blood in an Olympic-sized pool.
The whale shark has about 3,000 tiny teeth but filter-feeds plankton.
Sharks have been around for 450 million years — before trees existed.
Sharks have electroreceptors to detect prey's electrical fields.
